about: The introitus of the formulary “Saint Matthew, Apostle and Evangelist” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: The mouth of the just man will meditate wisdom, and his tongue will speak judgment; the law of his God is in his heart. Do not envy evildoers, nor be jealous of those who work iniquity. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. The mouth of the just man will meditate wisdom, and his tongue will speak judgment; the law of his God is in his heart.
